newsitem.title: USA: Independent Bank Corp plans offering.
newsitem.headline: Independent Bank Corp plans offering.

text.p: Independent Bank Corp Monday said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of $15 million in depositary shares that represent an interest in the company's cumulative, convertible preferred stock.
The terms of the depositary shares and the underlying preferred stock will be determined immediately prior to the sale, the bank holding company said.

In connection with this new financing, Independent Bank said it granted the sole underwriter, Stifel, Nicolaus & Co Inc, an option to purchase up to an additional 15 percent of the depositary shares to cover potential over-allotments.
Independent Bank had total assets of $793 million at September 30, 1996. Its four affiliate banks currently serve more than 45 communities in portions of Michigan's lower peninsula.
